model.network_use: Public model/source retrieval only; inference localCPU, no speechproviderAPI.

implementation: Unmodified pinned official utils_vad.py OnnxWrapper + get_speech_timestamps; PCM16 converted exactly to float32/32768; no filtering/normalization or reference-based tuning.
limits: Six public English/Urdu read-speech recordings plus three synthetic non-speech controls only; not target-phone or general acoustic acceptance.
Positive VAD means speech detected; it does not validate ASR words, numbers, language or clinical content.
Speech segmentation is used only as a presence gate; original audio remains the ASR input.
No speaker identification, microphone, Android runtime, TTS or physical2GB device is exercised.
